summary: Implemented the rich.progress open and wrap_file feature. Changes: rich/progress.py (private _ProgressReader, _build_progress, _progress_context helpers; module-level open and wrap_file with overloads; Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file methods), tests/test_progress.py (11 new tests before the script-entry block), docs/source/progress.rst (two new Advanced usage subsections), CHANGELOG.md (one Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 1759). The diff is purely additive: 734 insertions, 0 deletions. Nothing was committed. Tests, mypy, and black were not run, per the instructions, so all verification was by reading. Design choices: the context wrapper is a contextmanager generator, so no return-value suppression was needed on open; the reader defines mode and name properties for Python 3.6 abstract IO properties; the module-level open implementation types mode as Literal["r","rt","rb"] so it can call the overloaded Progress.open; readinto carries the no-untyped-def and override suppressions. Next step: run the test suite, mypy, and black on the changed files.
